pages.text: A crab scuttled sideways from under a rock. Riri and Lolo stopped walking.
They wanted to catch one crab. "Let us hold it just once, then let it go."
Riri began digging in the sand. Lolo already had both hands spread wide. "Wait, and it will fall in." "Pounce, and we can catch it."
Riri put a piece of bread beside the hole. She held her breath and waited quietly.
A seagull swooped down, swallowed the bread, and flew away.
Lolo pounced at the crab. It slipped away sideways.
The crab pinched Lolo's boot firmly with its claw. Lolo hopped up and down.
The crab let go of the boot and walked sideways. Lolo followed close behind.
Sideways, sideways went the crab—plop, into Riri's hole!
They peered into the hole. Riri opened her palm, and the crab quietly climbed onto it. Lolo held out the boot with the claw mark and laughed.
